scripts.build: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:win: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac:arm64: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-rebuild -f -w mediasoup --arch=arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.build:linux: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.clean:native: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('node_modules/mediasoup/worker/out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npm run rebuild:native
scripts.build:mac:x64: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-rebuild -f -w mediasoup --arch=x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64
scripts.build:mac:arm64:dir: cd ../viewer-web && npm run build && cd ../desktop-transmissor && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir
